cells.title: Source
body: "GlitchProber: Automated Detection and Evaluation of Glitch Tokens in Large Language Models" was submitted to arXiv in August 2024.
The paper proposed an automated method for finding and evaluating glitch-token behavior.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The authors treated glitch tokens as a measurable class of behavior rather than a one-off anecdote.
The paper described probing models with candidate tokens and measuring whether responses departed from ordinary token handling.

data.object: tokens that trigger abnormal model behavior
